data.body_html:
Start your day with a Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise 2037 — a private morning escape from Puerto Banús. Watch playful dolphins in their natural habitat while enjoying a delicious brunch with cava, wine, and fresh snacks. This 2-hour experience combines wildlife, luxury, and relaxation on the Costa del Sol.

All our charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Book via WhatsApp for personalised pricing and availability.

Why Choose a Morning Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise?

Morning is the best time for dolphin watching in Marbella. The sea is calm, the light is soft, and dolphins are most active near the coast. Departing from Puerto Banús, you'll cruise past the Golden Mile, Cabopino, and Cala del Faro — prime spots for sightings. Our skippers know the local waters and can navigate to areas where pods of bottlenose and common dolphins often feed.

Brunch is served on board: fresh pastries, seasonal fruit, Iberian ham, cheese, and a glass of cava. You can also opt for a full Spanish breakfast with tortilla, churros, and coffee.

Our Recommended Boat for Small Groups

For an intimate experience, the Dubhe (8m, 5 passengers) is perfect. It's a nimble motorboat with a sun pad and bimini top for shade. At €749 for 2 hours (all inclusive), it's the most affordable way to enjoy a private dolphin watching brunch cruise.

Larger groups can choose the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) — both €749/2h. For a premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski.

What's Included in Your Brunch Cruise

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (brunch menu with pastries, fruit, ham, cheese)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT) — no hidden fees

Dolphin Watching Tips for 2037

Best months: May to October. Morning departures (9:00–11:00) offer the highest chance of sightings. Bring sunglasses, sunscreen, and a light jacket. Our skippers will share insights about local marine life and conservation. If you're lucky, you might see tuna, sea turtles, or even whales.

We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and customised brunch menus (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free).

Explore More of Marbella's Coastline

Extend your cruise to 4 or 8 hours and visit Estepona, Sotogrande, or Caleta de Vélez. Anchor for a swim, explore hidden coves, or enjoy a seafood lunch at a chiringuito. Our skippers can tailor the route to your preferences.

For a full day, consider the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) — pricing on request via WhatsApp.
